div.div:
① Presentation Tier: Browser client establishes full-duplex HTTP 101 WebSocket to Streamlit on AWS ECS Fargate via ALB with sticky cookies.
② Identity & Auth: Streamlit UI initiates direct Cognito InitiateAuth; acquires IdToken and injects standard Bearer JWT across all API Gateway calls.
③ Direct S3 Ingestion: Multi-gigabyte binaries stream directly from client to S3 using Presigned PUT URLs, bypassing Lambda payload limits (6 MB).
④ Optimistic Concurrency (OCC): DynamoDB enforces conditional updates on version_id to guarantee atomic, collision-free metadata edits.
⑤ Event-Driven Async Indexing: DynamoDB Streams CDC events are queued in SQS and asynchronously synced to OpenSearch Serverless with DLQ isolation.
